title: Unit Event — The Power of Regret — Episode8 Because We're Serious

meta.Event Outline: Nene and her friends have made it to their final training destination, the Morinomiya Revue. While Nene goes into the experience excited to further grow as an actress, the boys' separate training and Emu's focus on business studies leave her attending practices on her own...

rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Here are the audition results for our next quarterly performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They already have the results...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(What do I do..?
I'm more nervous than when I was actually performing.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because Byakkomachi put on such an incredible performance after I'd gone.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: “Don't cry, Louise...”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
“Please, smile...
For you are the most beautiful rose... In the entire world...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was so overwhelmed...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I know I did everything I absolutely could.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (On top of Emu and the others helping me a ton, I used everything that Ms. Kazamatsuri taught me to build and polish my role.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All I can do is believe in myself...!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
We will begin with Luca.
He will be played by...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Ms. Byakkomachi.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: And Ito will be your understudy in case anything happens.

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Next, Louise will be played by...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I failed...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They didn't even choose me to be the understudy...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I guess that's only natural.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Byakkomachi was obviously amazing, but so were all the others.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Outside of the parts that involved singing, I wasn't really able to stand up to them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is really frustrating...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I did everything I could...
And I still wasn't enough...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now I understand...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is how Imura must've felt that time...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, those are the results.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: All of you will now need to shift your focus towards putting on the best performance you possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Understood...!
se_event_regret_2024_002
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Byakkomachi...
Do you have a second?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Kusanagi...
Yes, how can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wanted to congratulate you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Your Luca was staggering.
Break a leg for the actual performance, too.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, that's all...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Wait.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I also need to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The others certainly pushed me to do better, but you in particular gave me the most motivation.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Your acting and singing were both spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: From the moment you began singing until the second Luca took his last breath, you made it clear just how much he loved Louise.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I regretted not seeing it myself...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But what you did also made me want to surpass you.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Faced with your performance, I felt I had to win at all costs.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In other words, your singing lit a fire in me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My singing led to Byakkomachi's performance...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh...
Now I see...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is what it really means to push each other to become better.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (You win, you lose, you feel this regret and use it to hone your craft and yourself.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's how you really move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's what it means for everyone here to walk the same path together.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I need to compete more, myself.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(In order to keep growing.
In order to get closer to making my dream come true.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to face them head-on, and better myself, just like I did this time.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm beyond frustrated... And I really regret not being chosen for Luca...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I also know where I am as an actress now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Now I genuinely want to become better.
I want to keep moving forward, even if I have to compete to do it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm really glad that I had a chance to audition for this role.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to being blown away by your show, Byakkomachi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I promise to do my best backstage.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'll make it a performance worthy of the effort you put in, too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Still, Kusanagi, you and I are really alike...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I was stunned by your transformation.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You have a powerful desire to become a great actress who puts on incredible performances on stage. The same desire as me...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'm glad that someone like you decided to come train with us. So, let's keep pushing each other to become better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Absolutely!!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Since we're talking, would it be possible for you to tell me more about Wonderlands×Showtime?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'm really interested in learning more about what your troupe is like now. Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm standing here right now because the others helped me get to this point...
